title: Rotate the staging keys by Tuesday
transcript:
[00:00] Grace: Staging keys. The contractor who had access finished last week, so we rotate everything he could see.
[00:08] Mateo: That's the payments sandbox key, the email provider key, and the two internal service tokens.
[00:17] Grace: Right. Mateo, can you rotate all four by Tuesday November 3rd, 17:00 UTC?
[00:25] Mateo: Yes. Tuesday the 3rd, 17:00 UTC, all four.
[00:30] Grace: Done means the old keys are revoked at the provider, not just replaced, and the CI secrets are updated so the nightly build passes.
[00:42] Mateo: Got it. Revoked at the provider, CI secrets updated, nightly green.
[00:49] Grace: I'll check the provider dashboards on Wednesday morning and confirm the old keys show as revoked.
[00:57] Mateo: OK. I'll post in the infra channel as each one is done.
[01:03] Grace: Thanks. Production keys are out of scope. He never had access to those.
[01:10] Mateo: Understood. Staging only.
[01:13] Grace: And if a rotation breaks something, roll forward. Don't restore the old key.
[01:20] Mateo: Makes sense, the old ones will be revoked anyway.
[01:25] Grace: Great. That's all I had.
